variants.title: Stopping power of protons in carbon against energy (Bethe-Bloch)
variants.unknown: the stopping-power curve of protons in carbon and its minimum
variants.note: Carbon has fewer electrons per gram than water (Z/A 0.4996 against 0.5551, water's hydrogen is electron-rich), so its whole curve sits about 10 % lower. Graphite I = 78 eV.

source.title: PDG 'Atomic and nuclear properties of materials' / ICRU Reports 37 and 49: Z/A, mean excitation energy I, density
